ownerLogin.title: Customer login
ownerLogin.lead: Sign in as the paying workspace owner with your email and password.

staffLogin.title: Staff login
staffLogin.lead: Sign in with the Workspace ID, username, and password provided by your workspace owner.
staffLogin.workspaceIdHint: Provided by your workspace owner. Not your email or company name.
